checks: Every PNG card has exact original layout dimensions and expected rendition dimensions on forward/reverse walks; known tile geometry stays stable.
Offscreen image payloads/URLs release while every gallery tile remains.
Exact-size ArrayBuffer crosses real isolated desktop IPC with original SHA-256 and no base64 payload.
Every original full viewer has exact PNG dimensions/pixel, 1:1 zoom, focus return and last-owner release; card renditions are never used as originals.
Native Tab reaches the next image and restores its decoded content.
Open dialog and returned keyboard focus keep the shared image alive offscreen; blur permits release.
Known placeholders match decoded image geometry at narrow and wide native window sizes.
Duplicate local references share one owned pixel surface (or fallback Blob); removing one reference preserves the other.
Changing the source closes the old dialog, releases its resource and decodes the new source.
A missing file reports a local error; Retry reads the repaired file and renders it.
Each explicit Retry is fresh even while another duplicate reference holds a failed attempt.
Closing a pending preview and leaving its tile discards the late file response without recreating a Blob.
Remote image references remain explicit external-open buttons and create no remote image element.
Local SVG references decode through an owned Blob URL rather than a retained text/data URL.
APNG, GIF and WebP cards retain exact source bytes and animate; 16-bit PNG bypasses flattening; oriented JPEG and alpha PNG originals retain exact bytes/dimensions.
Transferred/decoded ImageBitmaps close to zero dimensions; no strong diagnostic references retain their pixels.
optimized.scope: Private Linux source Electron. Scroll request to decoded DOM includes IPC/polling; no canvas pixel checks in memory cohorts. Exact full-source pixels only in functional checks, outside timing samples; not physical input-to-paint. Fixed settling waits are outside visit times. Natural and explicit diagnostic cohorts are separate processes. Complete app-tree PSS only; no model/GPU-driver memory claim.

scope: Three alternating fresh pairs per memory scenario, or separate native functional cases. Memory excludes canvas pixel/hash and full-view checks. Four forward/reverse cycles, bottom revisit, clear/settle. Explicit diagnostic GC has a separate cohort. Per-case atomic checkpoints may resume only with identical mode, source, all built JS, harnesses and image bytes; only complete reports support cohort claims. No tests/builds overlap memory runs. Checkpoints are not continuous peaks, paint or GC pauses.
